message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal public holidays that create “long weekends”** in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re interested in provincial holidays—such as the Civic Holiday in Ontario, the St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or the various “Family Day” observances in other provinces—just let me know and I can add those too.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Why it’s a long weekend |
|-------------|---------|-------------|--------------------------|
| **Jan 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Sunday | Observed on **Mon Jan 2** → Sat Jan 1, Sun Jan 2, Mon Jan 3 |
| **Feb 20** (Monday) | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick) | Monday | Sat Feb 18, Sun Feb 19, Mon Feb 20 |
| **Apr 7** (Friday) | Good Friday | Friday | Fri Apr 7, Sat Apr 8, Sun Apr 9 |
| **May 22** (Monday) | Victoria Day | Monday | Sat May 20, Sun May 21, Mon May 22 |
| **Jul 1** (Saturday) | Canada Day | Saturday | Observed on **Mon Jul 3** → Sat Jul 1, Sun Jul 2, Mon Jul 3 |
| **Sep 4** (Monday) | Labour Day | Monday | Sat Sep 2, Sun Sep 3, Mon Sep 4 |
| **Oct 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | Monday | Sat Oct 7, Sun Oct 8, Mon Oct 9 |
| **Nov 11** (Monday) | Remembrance Day | Monday | Sat Nov 4, Sun Nov 5, Mon Nov 6 |
| **Dec 25** (Monday) | Christmas Day | Monday | Sat Dec 23, Sun Dec 24, Mon Dec 25 |

### Quick notes

* **Observed dates**: When a federal holiday falls on a weekend, the next weekday is observed as the holiday. That observation creates the long weekend (e.g., New Year’s Day is observed on Monday, Jul 1 Canada Day is observed on Monday, Jul 3).
* **Boxing Day** (Dec 26, Tuesday) does **not** create a long weekend in 2023 because it falls on a Tuesday.
* Some provinces observe additional holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., the Civic Holiday on the first Monday in August in most provinces, St. John’s Day on the third Monday in June in Newfoundland & Labrador). If you need those, just let me know!
